samples.title: 1 · Regular snoring (2.5 min)
samples.description: Steady snoring every few seconds in a quiet bedroom — expected: Normal.

samples.title: 2 · Pause-interrupted snoring (2.5 min)
samples.description: Snoring that repeatedly stops for 10–25 s and restarts with a loud snore or gasp — expected: Irregular pattern.

samples.title: 3 · Noisy phone recording, mixed night (3 min)
samples.description: Phone on a bedside table with fan/rain noise; regular snoring that turns irregular in the second half — shows how flagged segments are localised.

samples.title: 4 · Poor-quality recording (20 s)
samples.description: Mostly fan noise with barely audible breathing — expected: the app asks you to record again instead of guessing (US-09).
